source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Identify if the failure is a violation of a specific building code. Example: "Handrail on stairwell does not meet required height per IBC Section 1014.3."
3. Include a detailed description of the defect. Be specific! Instead of “Door is too narrow,” use “Door opening is 30 inches wide, minimum required width for accessible routes is 36 inches.”
4. Include the location of the defect. Be as specific as possible. Example: “North entrance, east side of door frame.”
5. Include photos documenting the defect. A picture is worth a thousand words!
6. Identify the remediation steps required to correct the defect. Example: “Widen door opening to 36 inches per ADA Standards for Accessible Design Section 404.2.4.”
7. Assign a priority level (High, Medium, Low) based on the severity of the defect and its impact
